subject.title: Claude CLI sessions reset on every turn in group channels due to groupIntro drift in extraSystemPromptHash

question: Should maintainers treat this issue as fixed once current-main soft resume ships, or keep it as the canonical tracker until live-session fingerprint and announce-path prompt drift are also fixed?
rationale: The original hard invalidation is partially mitigated on main, but current stable and active comments still show the same root class through live-session restarts and announce-driven turns; automation should not choose the canonical scope boundary.

options.title: Keep canonical until all variants are fixed
options.body: Use this issue to track groupIntro, announce-path, and live-fingerprint false invalidation until maintainers split or land all remaining scoped work.

options.title: Split after narrow group fix
options.body: Land or supersede the groupIntro PR, then move announce and live-fingerprint restart churn to separate canonical issues before closing this one.

options.title: Close after soft resume ships
options.body: Treat current-main soft resume as enough for the original amnesia report and require fresh issues for live-process churn or residual stable-release reports.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical until all variants are fixed
recommendation.body: Use this issue to track groupIntro, announce-path, and live-fingerprint false invalidation until maintainers split or land all remaining scoped work.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent main history put the latest session reuse and live fingerprint behavior in this person’s recent commits, making them the best available routing owner for the scope decision.
